One ruling file, workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/sources/ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm.md, about 706 lines (55 KB), scope the whole file. Lines 1-110 quote Sam verbatim, point by point from answers-2026-10-09-pm.md: search boxes (point 1), the prototype's JavaScript (point 3), ask-design rows (3a), live filtering and row lists (3b), commodities (2), documents (4), transporters (5), amend/cancel amendment/copy as new/delete (6), ownership of overview, check answers, declaration and confirmation (7), matching plants (7a), how plants changes are made (7b), the INS front door (8 and 8a) and the order of work (9). Lines 111-136 explain the orchestrator-versus-Sam marking, what ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates covers instead, the four evidence files and the design-question numbering. Lines 137-706 list 60 numbered claims in eleven lettered sections: (a) search boxes, claims 1-4; (b) the JavaScript rule, 5-7; (c) ask-design rows and design questions 1-13, 8-22; (d) rows built with GOV.UK or MoJ, 23-27; (e) commodities wait on MDM, 28-33; (f) transporter management waits, 34-37; (g) documents, 38; (h) ownership of overview/review/declaration/confirmation, 39-42; (i) plants changes in the same increment, 43-51; (j) the INS dashboard and the animals dashboard theme, 52-59; (k) ready against blocked, 60. Most claims are the orchestrator's application of Sam's principles and name backlog rows (inc-NNN), requirements (req-NNN) and conflicts (c-NNN). Nothing is left out of scope. Because the file is long and dense with row-by-row calls, it is cut into three parts on its lettered sections; every part reads the verbatim quote in full, because each listed claim is checked against it.

Extracted in 3 parts:
Part 1, Search boxes, the JavaScript rule and design questions: Part 1 of 3 (Search boxes, the JavaScript rule and design questions). Read the whole ruling file's lines 1-374 in full: the verbatim quote (lines 1-110), the preamble (lines 111-136) and sections (a) to (d) (lines 137-374). Claimed Sam's own words for points 1 (search boxes), 3 (the prototype's JavaScript), 3a (ask-design rows), 3b (live filtering and the row-lists remark) and 6 (amend, cancel amendment, copy as new and delete); the preamble's marking convention (Sam's rulings against the orchestrator's applications), what ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates covers instead, the four evidence files and the design-question numbering; and listed claims 1-27: (a) the search component against its content, row-by-row search box calls for inc-009 and inc-027, the roll-out left to EUDPA-635 (claims 1-4); (b) the JavaScript toolbox order, every page working without JavaScript, the library check (claims 5-7); (c) the ask-design split into a no-JavaScript build now and a waiting-on-design increment, live filtering waiting, and design questions 1-13 one row at a time (claims 8-22); (d) rows built with GOV.UK or MoJ or kept as today: banners staying, inc-063, inc-136, MoJ sub navigation, inc-137's Additional filters (claims 23-27). Each listed claim was checked against the quote: those marked 'Sam (point N)' are verbatim where the quote says them, and those marked 'applied by the orchestrator' are recorded as inferred, naming the principle they apply. The quote for points 2, 4, 5, 7, 7a, 7b, 8, 8a and 9 was read but belongs to the other parts' sections (e) to (k) and is not claimed here.
Part 2, Commodities, transporters, documents and page ownership: Part 2 read the ruling's preamble and the whole verbatim quote (lines 1-136) and sections (e) to (h), lines 375-495: (e) Commodities wait on MDM, claims 28-33; (f) Transporter management waits on requirements, claims 34-37; (g) Documents, claim 38; (h) Who owns the overview, check answers, declaration and confirmation, claims 39-42. Claims 28, 34, 38 and 39 are Sam's own decisions (points 2, 5, 4 and 7 of the quote); claims 29-33, 35-37 and 40-42 are the orchestrator's application of his principles, which the preamble says are not his rulings. This part claims Sam's decisions in the quote for points 2, 4, 5 and 7 as verbatim, each listed claim's rows and rules (orchestrator claims as inferred, quoting the listed claim's own words), and the gaps the quote leaves open.
Part 3, Plants in the same increment, dashboards and ready against blocked: Part 3 read the whole verbatim quote and preamble (lines 1-136) and sections (i) Plants changes in the same increment (claims 43-51), (j) The INS dashboard and the animals frontend's own dashboard (claims 52-59) and (k) Ready against blocked (claim 60), lines 496 to the end.
